definitions.explanation: Suffix attaching to a noun to mark a part or installment of a book, course, video series, or themed collection.

examples.english: I read the basics volume first.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧{編|へん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The advanced volume will be published next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧{編|へん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{語彙|ごい}{編|へん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}みましょう→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Once you finish the grammar section, let's move on to the vocabulary section.

notes:
Names a part, installment, or themed chapter of a larger work. Often paired in series ({前|ぜん}{編|へん} / {後|こう}{編|へん}, ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧{編|へん} / ⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧{編|へん}).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧{編|へん}: basics volume
- ⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧{編|へん}: advanced/applied volume
- {前|ぜん}{編|へん}: first part / earlier volume
- {後|こう}{編|へん}: latter part / sequel volume
- ⟦{完|かん}{結|けつ}{編|へん}→完結編：20712_kanketsuhen⟧: final installment

USAGE:
Common in textbooks, anime/film series, manga arcs, and TV documentaries. Also written as a kanji that means 'to edit, compile', reflecting the sense of an editorial unit of a larger work.
